lines.text: BlizzCon 2026 streams Sep 12-13, with a four-reward WoW drop campaign on Twitch (through Sep 27) and YouTube
Twilight Trails opens with Mega Squads Sep 8-14, the Horizons Celebration Sep 16-22, and Harvest Festival Sep 29 - Oct 5 with Shiny Applin's debut
September's Community Day Classic is confirmed as Gible, and the Sep 19 Super Mega Raid Day debuts Mega Staraptor
GO Fest: Mega Finale, the 10th Anniversary Mewtwo research and the Time to Aniimo web event have ended

needs_you.action: Last hours for the Ensemble: Sorcerer's Grassy Garb Twitch drop, which ends today at 10:00 a.m. PDT after 4 hours watched
Claim your GO Pass: August rewards before they expire Sep 10 at 10am local
Evolve Gabite by 9pm local on Gible Community Day Classic for Earth Power Garchomp; the $1.99 Special Research is only worth buying before the 2-5pm event
Use the GO Pass Deluxe: August Lucky Trinket before it expires at 11:59pm local
Buy Midnight at up to 40% off before the Battle.net Game Deals sale ends Sep 13
Rank up GO Pass: Mega Squads before it closes Sep 14 at 8pm local, then claim its rewards by Sep 16 at 8pm
Pre-order the Advanced ($9.99) or Collector's ($19.99) Edition before the Sep 16 launch if you want the platform-exclusive Fluffy Friend or Doggo Dude accessory
Attending BlizzCon in person? Link your BlizzCon Pass to Battle.net by Sep 18 or the in-game rewards will not be delivered
The $4.99 Staraptor Super Mega Raid Day ticket is only sold until Sep 19 at 5pm local, and its bonuses only apply during the 2-5pm event
Rank up the Horizons Celebration GO Pass before it closes Sep 22 at 8pm local, then claim its rewards by Sep 24 at 8pm
Finish the $1.99 Phantump Catch Mastery paid Timed Research by 8pm local the same day, or its rewards are lost
Watch up to 12 hours of eligible WoW Twitch streams before Sep 27 at 10:00 a.m. PDT for the BlizzCon drops, including the Fluffy Comfy Flying Quilt mount
Buy the World of Warcraft BlizzCon Bundle before the individual BlizzCon bundles leave the Battle.net Shop Sep 28
Finish the September Traveler's Log for the Crested Ember Leafmimic mount and spend or freeze Trader's Tender before the Trading Post rotates Sep 30
Claim every LEGO Stores reward, including the stamp rally Pikachu and avatar jacket, by Sep 30 at 11:59pm local
Finish the Harvest Festival branching apple research by Oct 5 at 8pm local, and claim its GO Pass rewards by Oct 7 at 8pm
Rank up GO Pass: September before rank earning stops Oct 6 at 10am local, using the uncapped GO Points on Oct 3 and 4; rewards expire Oct 8
Redeem the Chansey Plant code P0K0P1AGARDENS at a Pokemon Center PC before it stops working Oct 7
Hatch with the GO Pass Deluxe: September Timed Incubator before it expires Oct 13 at 10am local

games.typical_lead_time: in-game calendar visible 4+ weeks out; shop and patch news 1-2 weeks

timeline.title: Curse of Ula'tek
timeline.detail: The Coiled Isle is open with the Vaults of Atal'Utek, Curse Surges and Cursed Fishing, the Altar of Fangs dungeon, three new Delves, the Tidebound Grotto Lair, Housing Blueprints and four new neighborhood Endeavors.

timeline.title: Midnight Season 2 and the Venomous Abyss
timeline.detail: Season 2 continues with the eight-boss Venomous Abyss plus Mythic+, PvP Season 2 and Bountiful Delves; Raid Finder Wing 3 opened Sep 1 and Wing 4 unlocks with this week's reset.

timeline.title: Twitch Drop: Sorcerer's Grassy Garb
timeline.detail: Last chance: watch 4 hours of any eligible World of Warcraft stream and claim the Ensemble: Sorcerer's Grassy Garb before today, Sep 8, at 10:00 a.m. PDT.

timeline.title: Darkmoon Faire
timeline.detail: Darkmoon Island is open through Sep 12 for tickets, profession quests, and the monthly carousel and top-hat experience buffs.

timeline.title: Battle.net Game Deals: 40% off Midnight
timeline.detail: Midnight is up to 40% off through Sep 13 on the Battle.net Shop, alongside discounts on select game services.

timeline.title: Trading Post: friendship in September
timeline.detail: September's rotation offers the Crested Ember Leafmimic mount as the Traveler's Log reward, plus special Outlet vendors with discounted and returning items; spend or freeze Tender by Sep 30.

timeline.title: WoW BlizzCon 2026 Bundle
timeline.detail: Buy the bundle (Rabbit'ath flying mount, Ensemble: Garb of the Dawnfire Phoenix, Perch of the Dawnfire Phoenix housing decor) on the Battle.net Shop by Sep 28, when the individual BlizzCon bundles leave the shop.

timeline.title: Vibrant Petalweave Collection
timeline.detail: Four floral transmog ensembles (Sunlit, Blush, Azure, Scarlet) are in the in-game Shop and on Battle.net, sold as a bundle or individually, with the price adjusting for pieces you already own.

timeline.title: BlizzCon 2026
timeline.detail: BlizzCon returns to Anaheim with livestreamed WoW What's Next and Deep Dive panels, the AWC and MDI Grand Finals, and a Day One Opening Ceremony at 10:30 a.m. PDT.

timeline.title: BlizzCon viewership drops
timeline.detail: Watch eligible WoW streams for 2, 4, 8 and 12 hours for 200 Trader's Tender, the Cuddly Blue Grrgle decor, the Fluffy Comfy Flying Quilt mount and a banner toy; Twitch runs Sep 12 at 9:30 a.m. PDT to Sep 27 at 10:00 a.m. PDT, YouTube only through Sep 13 at 7:00 p.m. PDT.

timeline.title: Cataclysm Timewalking
timeline.detail: The Cataclysm dungeon rotation returns Sep 15 with its own weekly quest and Timewarped vendor.

timeline.title: Pirates' Day (micro-holiday)
timeline.detail: Talk to the Dread Captain in Booty Bay for the one-day pirate costume buff and its achievement.

timeline.title: Brewfest
timeline.detail: Brewfest opens Sep 20 outside Ironforge and Orgrimmar with daily Coren Direbrew runs, Brewfest Prize Tokens, and the ram and kodo mounts.

timeline.title: Harvest Festival
timeline.detail: Honor Uther and Grom at their memorials for the week-long Harvest Festival quest and its bounty of food.

timeline.title: Darkmoon Faire (October)
timeline.detail: The Faire should reopen Oct 3 for its usual week of tickets, profession quests and carousel buffs.
timeline.estimate_basis: Darkmoon Faire opens the first Saturday of each month

timeline.title: The Great Gnomeregan Run (micro-holiday)
timeline.detail: Race a level-1 gnome from Gnomeregan to Booty Bay in the annual weekend fun run.

timeline.title: Midnight 12.1.5: The Promise of Tomorrow
timeline.detail: The next content update, now on the PTR with no release date announced, concludes the Quel'thalas saga with the one-boss Unbinding of Kith'ix raid, Labyrinths, hourly Aqir Invasions and Ascendant Venomstones.
timeline.estimate_basis: On the PTR; Blizzard has not announced a release date

weekly_rhythm: Week of Sep 8 (now): Midnight Dungeon Event; PvP Brawl: Southshore vs Tarren Mill; Raid Finder Wing 4 opens; Darkmoon Faire through Sep 12
Week of Sep 15: Cataclysm Timewalking; PvP Brawl: Classic Ashran; Pirates' Day Sep 19 and Brewfest from Sep 20
Week of Sep 22: Arena Skirmish Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Packed House; Harvest Festival through Sep 28; BlizzCon Twitch drops close Sep 27
Week of Sep 29: World Quest Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Deep Six; the Trading Post rolls over Sep 30
Week of Oct 6: Timewalking Dungeon Event; PvP Brawl: Arathi Blizzard; Brewfest ends Oct 6; Gnomeregan Run Oct 10-12
Week of Oct 13 (window end): Battleground Bonus Event and PvP Brawl: Gravity Lapse begin at reset
just_past_window: Oct 20-27: Delves Bonus Event and PvP Brawl: Deepwind Dunk
Oct 27 - Nov 3: Timewalking Dungeon Event and PvP Brawl: Shado-Pan Showdown

games.typical_lead_time: events usually announced 1-4 weeks ahead; season schedule posted at season start

timeline.title: Season 24: Twilight Trails
timeline.detail: The new season starts today at 10am local with more Paldea debuts including Maschiff and Mabosstiff, Mega Evolution debuts for Staraptor and Chandelure, and Dynamax Rhyhorn, Sneasel and Sizzlipede in Max Battles.

timeline.title: GO Pass: September
timeline.detail: Rank toward a Latios encounter; Deluxe is $7.99 or $9.99 with 10 ranks, GO Points are uncapped Oct 3-4, rank earning ends Oct 6 at 10am local, rewards expire Oct 8 at 10am, and the Rank 20 Timed Incubator expires Oct 13.

timeline.title: Mega Squads
timeline.detail: Maschiff and Mabosstiff debut alongside Shiny Flamigo, Mega Beedrill and Mega Houndoom get the new Super Max Mega Level, and a free event GO Pass ($4.99 Deluxe) runs to Sep 14 at 8pm local with rewards claimable through Sep 16.

timeline.title: GO Battle League: Twilight Trails
timeline.detail: Ranks reset Sep 8 at 1:00 p.m. PDT and Mega-Evolved Pokemon are eligible in the new Mega Editions of all three leagues; a free Timed Research Pass, Ryme-inspired avatar items and a guaranteed Pikachu Libre rank-up encounter come with the season.

timeline.title: LEGO Stores and Pokemon GO
timeline.detail: Participating US LEGO Stores host boosted Pikachu raids, a stamp rally leading to Special Background Pikachu, a LEGO-branded avatar jacket via Timed Research, and a SMART Play demo; everything must be claimed by Sep 30 at 11:59pm local.

timeline.title: Community Day Classic: Gible
timeline.detail: Gible swarms with Shiny and Special Background odds from 2pm to 5pm local; evolve Gabite by 9pm for Earth Power Garchomp, with a $1.99 Special Research, a Garchomp Mega Energy Collection Challenge, and Gible on regular Lures until 9pm.

timeline.title: Pokemon Horizons Celebration
timeline.detail: Charmander wearing Friede's goggles debuts (evolvable to Charizard in goggles), Pikachu in Cap's hat returns to one-star raids, day and night wild spawns rotate, and an event GO Pass ($4.99 Deluxe) runs to Sep 22 at 8pm local, rewards claimable through Sep 24.

timeline.title: Staraptor Super Mega Raid Day
timeline.detail: Mega Staraptor debuts in Super Mega Raids with Super Max unlockable and boosted Shiny odds; up to six free Raid Passes from Gym spins, a $4.99 ticket (sold until 5pm local) for up to 14, and the remote raid limit rises to 20 from Sep 18 at 5pm to Sep 19 at 8pm PDT.

timeline.title: Phantump Catch Mastery
timeline.detail: Throw-accuracy Field Research and free Timed Research bring boosted Shiny Phantump with 2x XP and extra Candy for Nice throws or better; $1.99 paid Timed Research adds more Phantump and must be finished by 8pm local that day.

timeline.title: Harvest Festival: Applin Picking
timeline.detail: Shiny Applin debuts, Mossy Lures dispense Tart, Sweet and Syrupy Apples, and a branching apple Timed Research plus an event GO Pass ($4.99 Deluxe) run to Oct 5 at 8pm local, with pass rewards claimable through Oct 7.

timeline.title: Harvest Festival: Taken Over
timeline.detail: Team GO Rocket floods PokeStops and balloons from Oct 2 at 12:00am to Oct 5 at 8pm local; chase Giovanni with the GO Pass Super Rocket Radar to save Shadow Zekrom, hatch the debuting Shiny Shroodle, and TM away Frustration.

timeline.title: Max Battle Day
timeline.detail: A Max Battle Day is dated Oct 3 from 2pm to 5pm local, on the same weekend GO Pass: September drops its daily GO Point limit; the featured Pokemon is unannounced, though the season roadmap promises Dynamax Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf in a Max Battle Day this season.

timeline.title: October Community Day
timeline.detail: Season 24's first full Community Day runs 2pm to 5pm local; the featured Pokemon has not been announced yet.

weekly_rhythm: Spotlight Hour is Thursdays 6-7pm local, plus an extra Sunday Spotlight Hour Sep 13; Raid Hour is Wednesdays 6-7pm local; Max Monday runs 6am-9pm local
Spotlight Hours: Weedle, Kakuna and Beedrill Sep 10; Houndour and Houndoom Sun Sep 13; a mystery Pokemon Sep 17; Rattata Sep 24
Max Mondays: Rhyhorn Sep 14, Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres Sep 21, Sobble Sep 28
5-star raids: Zacian Sep 9-15; Zamazenta Sep 16-22; Xurkitree, Pheromosa and Buzzwole Sep 23-29; Xerneas Sep 30 - Oct 6; the Oct 6-13 rotation is not announced yet
Raid Hours: Zacian Sep 9; Zamazenta Sep 16; the Ultra Beast trio Sep 23; Xerneas Sep 30
Mega Raids: Beedrill Sep 8-15 joined by Houndoom Sep 11-15; Venusaur Sep 16-22; Malamar Sep 23-29; Victreebel Sep 30 - Oct 6
Shadow Raids on weekends: Shadow Thundurus (Incarnate Forme) Sep 9 - Oct 6
GO Battle League: Mega Editions of all three leagues Sep 8-15, then Willpower Cup Sep 15-22, Retro Cup Sep 22-29, Mega Color Cup Sep 29 - Oct 6, and Mega Editions again Oct 6-13
Season 24's Community Days are Sep 12 (Gible Classic), Oct 10 and Nov 21

games.typical_lead_time: in-game events announced only 4-7 days ahead; DLC and update news months ahead

timeline.title: PokemonXP and Worlds Cloud Island
timeline.detail: Grab the mysterious goggles from any Pokemon Center in an area at environment level 3 or above and enter address JW7MXKP2 to tour the Worlds stage island; no end date has been announced.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Chansey Plant
timeline.detail: Enter code P0K0P1AGARDENS at any Pokemon Center PC (Mystery Gift, code entry) for a placeable Chansey Plant; codes are region free and valid through Oct 7.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Ditto Rug
timeline.detail: Claim the Ditto Rug at any Pokemon Center PC via the internet Mystery Gift option, no code needed; available through Jan 31, 2027.

timeline.title: Expansion Pass: Part 1 out now
timeline.detail: Part 1, Bubbly Basin, is live on the eShop and needs the Bleak Beach environment request plus the new Dive move; buying the pass before Aug 31, 2027 also mails a code for 30 rare Pokemetal ingots.

just_past_window: No in-game event is running or announced right now; the last one, Fetching Scales for Feebas, ended Aug 28
Expansion Pass Part 2 arrives in late 2026 with new accessories, furniture and Pokemon but no new town; Part 3 and its new town follow in 2027

games.typical_lead_time: official news posts land 1-2 weeks ahead; launch dates confirmed by Pawprint

timeline.title: Pre-order editions
timeline.detail: The Advanced Edition ($9.99) bundles the Advanced Companion Handbook and the Fluffy Friend accessory; the Collector's Edition ($19.99) adds a Prismana egg, doll and avatar frame, with Doggo Dude exclusive to Xbox pre-orders.

timeline.title: Global launch on PC and consoles
timeline.detail: Aniimo goes free-to-play worldwide Sep 16 on PS5, Xbox Series X and S, PC and Xbox cloud gaming, with a reworked Irisalis legendary encounter, flat Prismana odds and simplified training at launch; closed-beta Bond Pact eggs are reclaimed by logging in with the same account and channel.

timeline.title: Mobile launch
timeline.detail: iOS and Android follow a week after the PC and console release, on the same global servers.

just_past_window: A post-launch update will add NVIDIA ACE voice interaction with your Aniimo; no date announced
